result.title: ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors
result.summary: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at https://h0xg.github.io/ProManO/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何把前馈几何预测升级到度量尺度：证明与已标定内参相容的变换构成十维流形，指出 Sim(3) 缺失的平面-at-infinity 三自由度会使残差随深度二次增长，并提出按沿射线不确定性与内点概率加权的 EM 流形优化框架 ProManO，仅在可观测处精修。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 VIO 几何标定而非 VLM 推理，但其「按不确定性加权稀疏锚点、只在可观测自由度上修正」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 视觉状态如何以证据可靠性加权地锚定与修正几何细节，以及过度校正带来的失真诊断。
